from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_bars = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    bar_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in row_bars}
    col_bars = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] in bar_colors]
    divider_colors = bar_colors | {grid[0][c] for c in col_bars}
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x not in divider_colors)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    r_edges = [-1] + row_bars + [h]
    c_edges = [-1] + col_bars + [w]
    return [[background if sum(grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] not in divider_colors
                               for r in range(ra + 1, rb) for c in range(ca + 1, cb)) == 1 else 1
             for ca, cb in zip(c_edges, c_edges[1:])]
            for ra, rb in zip(r_edges, r_edges[1:])]
